step: STEP 54D-FIX-2 — HISTORICAL ↔ CURRENT RISK MAP SEPARATION

historical_source.name: NASA Global Landslide Catalog (GLC)
historical_source.data_integrity: 100% real past incident records; zero synthetic or hardcoded coordinates

current_source.name: Real-time Multi-hazard Telemetry & ML Prediction Engine
current_source.empty_state_behavior: Displays honest notice: 'No active risk assessments available for this area.' Zero fabricated markers.

data_layer_separation.orthogonal_risk_data_control: [ HISTORICAL ] ('Past landslide activity') ↔ [ CURRENT ] ('Current AI risk assessment')
data_layer_separation.basemap_switching_invariance: Never alters selected risk mode, marker coordinates, count, selection, pointer, center, or zoom
data_layer_separation.risk_mode_switching_invariance: Never alters active basemap, map center, zoom, selected location, or pointer

historical_data_transparency.source_dataset: NASA Global Landslide Catalog (GLC) (176 NER records)
historical_data_transparency.spatial_aggregation_method: Great-circle distance neighborhood query using the Haversine formula
historical_data_transparency.spatial_scale_rationale: 10 km corresponds to typical micro-watershed and contiguous slope-facet complexes in the rugged Himalayan and Northeast India terrain.

HIGH.label: High Historical Landslide Activity
HIGH.meaning: Severe recurrent past landslide activity hotspot

MEDIUM.label: Medium Historical Landslide Activity
MEDIUM.meaning: Moderate concentration of documented past events

INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.label: No/Insufficient Historical Evidence
INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.meaning: Sparse or isolated historical records; insufficient evidence to establish statistical recurrence

semantic_safety_rules: Never labeled as Current Risk, Current Hazard, Prediction, or Guaranteed Future Risk
Historical activity alone NEVER triggers early warning alerts (WATCH, WARNING, CRITICAL)
Sparse data renders 'No/Insufficient Historical Evidence' rather than falsely pretending low risk
